premises.text: Good ideas get lost across desktop, Dropbox, inbox, and other repositories
premises.evidence_span: Is it in my desktop? Is it in my Dropbox? Is it in my inbox? Where is my great idea?

premises.text: Docurated discovers files across repositories and strips them into reusable components such as pages, charts, text, and images
premises.evidence_span: discover all of your files across any repository, email, desktop, third parties

premises.text: Indexed normalized components return the best page by content and context relevance from one search, improving with use and without tagging via NLP
premises.evidence_span: your best page, not a file, your best page appears to you in the order of relevance

premises.text: Pages can be mashed into a visual collage and exported to PowerPoint or PDF regardless of original format, then shared or saved
premises.evidence_span: export that collage into PowerPoint or PDF, irregardless of where the pages came from, irregardless of the file format

premises.text: The product is offered to individuals with Dropbox accounts, not only large enterprises
premises.evidence_span: If you have a Dropbox account, DocuRated is yours

value.text: One place where ideas and best content are at your fingertips to find and reuse
value.evidence_span: one place where all of our ideas are at our fingertips

causal_links.evidence_span: Finding ideas is a huge problem
your best content, your best page, not a file, your best page appears to you
Each page can be mashed up from any other page, from any other file format
We believe that DocuRated belongs to everyone

notes: Customer testimonial (Paul Bree) excluded as non-founder speech (4.2.5). $9B enterprise spend treated as market framing. Brains feature list (index, learn, NLP) folded into P3 (v1.3.2 4.1(5)).
